page.layout: One text column, with two marginal notes in the left margin beside the text. The page number and running head sit at the top, and the catchword "A Luce" sits at the bottom right.

main_text.p: tamen omnem Elementarem qualitatem graduatam necesse est.

Videtur autem Essentia stellarum consistere, 1. In interiore corporis globosi purissima luciditate, qua tota interior substantia, plena lucis congregatione perfusa, apta est, lucem suam lumen & radios diffundere. 2. In lucida essentia in globum compactione & efformatione, qua per insitam Virtutem motricem est apposita ferri motu orbico, suasque conficere periodos.
Quidam excipiunt a prima parte Lunam, quae videtur aliquid impuritatis obtinere, quam maculae ejus ostendere dicuntur. Deinde dictante Spiritu Veritatis, stellae lucis gloria sunt impares.
Stellarum affectio est Interior, vel Exterior.Stellarum affectio.
Interior ab ipsa magis dimanat & dependet stellarum essentia.
main_text.head: Estq; Lux & Motus.
main_text.p: Lux stellarum est interior & formalis earum affectio, seu proprietas visibilis, primo & per se in stellis lucens, radiorum ac luminis coelestis inferiori mundo communicati fons.Stellarum Lux.

p.i: Hujus vis est, omnia lucem apta recipere in mundo collustrare, & tenebras dispellere.

page.notes: The running head is printed as "LIBRI SECVNDI" and has been normalised to SECUNDI. The catchword at the bottom right is partly cut off; it reads as "A Luce". The page number "82" is printed at the top left in a worn form. The two margin notes are printed in italic in the left margin.
